home_load_kw.description: Discharge-flow limits (09-optimizer-dispatcher-update.md S1.9 F2/G11). Home electrical load before PV, kW, >= 0. Optional and additive.

pv_kw.description: PV generation at the hub, kW, >= 0 (S1.9 F2). Optional and additive.

meter_kw.description: Site meter net power, kW, + = import (S1.9 F2's M_i = L_net + p_kw). Optional and additive.

cell_temp_c.description: Battery cell temperature, degrees C (S1.9 F1 derating input). Optional and additive.

p_dis_max_kw.description: The battery's own SoC/temperature-derated maximum discharge power, kW (S1.9 F1). Optional and additive.

p_ch_max_kw.description: The battery's own SoC/temperature-derated maximum charge power, kW (S1.9 F1). Optional and additive.

peak_power_budget_kws.description: Above-continuous peak-power budget B_i, kW*s (S1.9 F5). 0 while peak == continuous (OQ-10). Optional and additive.

lat.description: Deterministic hub latitude, degrees (owner UI request, 2026-09-26). Optional and additive.

lon.description: Deterministic hub longitude, degrees (owner UI request, 2026-09-26). Optional and additive.

charge_pv_kw.description: Charging power sourced from on-site solar (owner decision D-28, 2026-09-26). >= 0; 0 when not charging. Optional and additive.

charge_grid_kw.description: Charging power sourced from the grid (owner decision D-28, 2026-09-26). >= 0; 0 when not charging; charge_pv_kw + charge_grid_kw is the hub's total charging power. Optional and additive.

pq.description: Per-phase electrical quality (06-service-profiles-and-power-quality.md S6.1). Optional and additive: existing consumers that ignore unknown fields keep working unchanged.

v_rms.description: line-neutral or line-line RMS voltage, V
